<script>
(function(){
  var t=document.getElementById('thmtable'); if(!t) return;
  var tb=t.tBodies[0];
  var activeDom='';
  var fInput=document.getElementById('thmfilter');
  function val(tr,i){var td=tr.cells[i];return td.getAttribute('data-v')!==null?td.getAttribute('data-v'):td.textContent.trim();}
  function num(x){var n=parseFloat(x);return isNaN(n)?null:n;}
  var dir={};
  t.tHead.querySelectorAll('th[data-sort]').forEach(function(th){
    th.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var idx=Array.prototype.indexOf.call(th.parentNode.cells,th);
      var rows=Array.prototype.slice.call(tb.rows);
      var d=dir[idx]=!dir[idx];
      rows.sort(function(a,b){
        var x=val(a,idx),y=val(b,idx),nx=num(x),ny=num(y),r;
        if(nx!==null&&ny!==null)r=nx-ny; else r=x.localeCompare(y);
        return d?r:-r;
      });
      rows.forEach(function(r){tb.appendChild(r);});
    });
  });
  function applyFilter(){
    var q=(fInput?fInput.value:'').toLowerCase();
    Array.prototype.slice.call(tb.rows).forEach(function(r){
      var okText=r.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(q)>-1;
      var okDom=!activeDom||r.getAttribute('data-dom')===activeDom;
      if(okText&&okDom){r.classList.remove('hide-row');}else{r.classList.add('hide-row');}
    });
  }
  if(fInput)fInput.addEventListener('input',applyFilter);
  document.querySelectorAll('.thm-chip').forEach(function(chip){
    chip.addEventListener('click',function(){
      document.querySelectorAll('.thm-chip').forEach(function(c){
        c.classList.remove('active');
        if(c.getAttribute('data-dom')!==''){c.style.background='#fff';c.style.color='#374151';}
      });
      chip.classList.add('active');
      var dom=chip.getAttribute('data-dom');
      if(dom!==''){var col=chip.getAttribute('data-color')||'#374151';chip.style.background=col;chip.style.color='#fff';}
      activeDom=dom;
      applyFilter();
    });
  });
})();
</script>
